Chapter 541: Chapter 2: The Junior Apprentice Brother Is Ninth Rank, And We Are Still Sixth Rank? (Please Subscribe) - 2

Chapter 541: Chapter 2: The Junior Apprentice Brother is Ninth Rank, and We Are Still Sixth Rank? (Please Subscribe) – 2

“The general ‘Pan Yong’ who was initially in charge of the matter has already committed suicide out of fear of crime…”

Someone immediately reported.

“Committed suicide out of fear of crime?”

The Insect Race Hive then fell silent.

…

“My son has become a Ninth Rank Evolver?”

...

Lin Shoucheng looked at Canglan Star, which was engulfed in jubilation, and was somewhat bewildered.

Over the years, news about Lin Yuan came one after another, each more outrageous than the last. Now, he had even advanced to the Ninth Rank?

Even if Lin Shoucheng did not understand the implications of the Ninth Rank, he was aware that it was a real pillar of human civilization and that beings of such a level generally would not appear before ordinary citizens.

“Absolutely true, Mr. Lin, you have a remarkable son…”

Governor Song Wuyang’s face also retained a look of shock. He himself had once had a conversation with Lin Yuan, the evolutionary genius he had admired, who had now astonishingly become a Ninth Rank Evolver.

Because Lin Yuan had become a Ninth Rank, the entire Canglan Star fell into jubilation once again.

There was no significant reason, purely a celebration that a Ninth Rank Evolver had been born on this planet.

The territories of human civilization are vast with countless higher life planets, yet, historically, none had ever produced a Ninth Rank Evolver.

And now Canglan Star had done it?

In fact, not only was Canglan Star celebrating, the entire Dawn Star System was in jubilation since Lin Yuan, the Ninth Rank Evolver, was also from the Dawn Star System.

“Brother is too amazing.”

Lin Yi also received this message on the side, a look of disbelief appearing on her face.

Compared to her brother, she, as his sister, was far too mediocre. However, Lin Yi hadn’t thought about catching up with her brother.

How could she catch up?

With what could she catch up?

…

“Our junior brother has entered Ninth Rank?”

In a virtual world, the Peak Masters of the Chikun lineage were gathering to chat.

Then, they received this earth-shattering news, leaving the Peak Masters who were casually chatting completely dumbfounded.

“Who would have thought that I, Zuo Ge, would one day be fortunate enough to be the senior brother of a Ninth Rank Evolver…”

Peak Master Zuo Ge was feeling sentimental. He still remembered what Lin Yuan was like when he first became the Thirteenth Peak Master.

“Freakish, truly freakish.”

“We are still Sixth Rank, and our once junior brother has already become Ninth Rank…”

Peak Master Five could not help but speak out. He bore no jealousy; if the difference was small, it might have sparked feelings of envy, but when the gap is as vast as a chasm, one can only admire in awe.

And now, Lin Yuan, having become a Ninth Rank, the gap between them was more than just a chasm.

“I was almost about to take junior brother under my wing back then…”

Peak Master Twelve felt sentimental. Initially, he saw that Lin Yuan had some research in the Path of Sun, which partially overlapped with his own, and he considered taking Lin Yuan as his student, but later he saw Lin Yuan’s ‘ineffective’ actions at the Seventh Star Cave.

He did not speak up.

But in reality, Lin Yuan was at that time contemplating the ultimate test of evolution at the Seventh Star Cave.

He was simply blind to what Lin Yuan was doing.

…

“My disciple has entered Ninth Rank?”

Chikun Star Lord also received this news, and he was not surprised.

These years, Chikun Star Lord had already become accustomed to being shocked by Lin Yuan’s performance.

Not to mention stepping into Ninth Rank, even if Lin Yuan now broke through to Tenth Rank.

Chikun Star Lord felt he wouldn’t be too shocked.

His disciple was best at breaking existing awareness and creating various miracles.

“I originally thought I could breakthrough to Ninth Rank before my disciple…”

Chikun Star Lord sighed. He was also close to the Ninth Rank, and the fusion rules had already reached the final step.

If lucky, he could take the last step in a few days, then evolve towards Ninth Rank.

If unlucky, it would be a matter of a few decades or a few hundred years at most.

Chikun Star Lord had originally thought that he might be able to step into the Ninth Rank before Lin Yuan.

After all, he was just one step away and could break through at any time.

“No way.”

“This seclusion, I must step into Ninth Rank.”

“Otherwise, I won’t have the face to see my disciple.”

Although human civilization is not short of cases where the disciple surpasses the teacher.

But Chikun Star Lord still cared about his dignity; originally Lin Yuan had killed dozens of Eighth Rank invincibles in a few breaths, but his life essence was still at the Eighth Rank.

So Chikun Star Lord felt meeting each other wouldn’t be too awkward.

They were within the same great realm.

But now.

Lin Yuan had clearly stepped into Ninth Rank.

If he was still Eighth Rank, it would be too embarrassing.

“This seclusion will last for twenty years.”

“Twenty years later, I must step into the Ninth Rank,”

“By then, I won’t be too ashamed in front of my disciple.”

Chikun Star Lord had made a detailed plan for his retreat.

He immediately notified that for the next twenty years, unless there was a major event, no one should disturb him.

“Ninth Rank.”

“I, Chikun, am here as well.”

Chikun Star Lord closed his eyes.

…

Wanyang Star Domain.

Wanyang Holy Son was leisurely lying there, resting.

Since he had completely removed Shisan from his list of targets to surpass, Wanyang Holy Son felt remarkably at ease.

That’s the way it should be.

Why bother comparing himself with that freak, Shisan Peak Master, if it wasn’t necessary?

Wasn’t that just asking for trouble?

Wanyang Holy Son trembled slightly as he thought about the news of Shisan Peak Master going on a killing spree on the battlefield of different races.

Even now, he was shocked and his scalp numbed by the message; how was it possible for an Eighth Layer invincible being to be slaughtered so indiscriminately by another of his rank?

“Hmm?”

“The Central Star Domain issued a notice?”

Wanyang Holy Son glanced at the notice, “Shisan Peak Master has stepped into the Ninth Rank?”

Wanyang Holy Son blinked, feeling it was just as it should be.

“Luckily I didn’t keep comparing myself to that freak.”

“Otherwise, how desperate would I be right now?”

“Comparing myself at Sixth Rank to someone at Ninth Rank?”

Wanyang Holy Son felt somewhat relieved.

Sometimes it’s wise to know when to give up.

…

The news of Lin Yuan stepping into the Ninth Rank had a profound impact on human civilization and other different species; everyone knew Lin Yuan had truly grown up.

The next time Lin Yuan took action, it wouldn’t just affect a medium-sized otherworldly battlefield but the large alien battlefields that were the main battlegrounds for the various clans.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan’s thoughts shifted.

Taiyin Primordial Spirit immediately moved out from his inner world.

It sat in front of Lin Yuan.

“Has it completely transformed?”

Lin Yuan carefully observed the Taiyin Primordial Spirit.

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit was also continuously observing itself.

“Indeed a fleshly body.”

“No longer a soul body.”

Lin Yuan finally concluded.

“The ‘Blood Rebirth’ Divine Ability Imprint…”

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit quickly condensed this divine skill’s imprint within, crucial to absorbing the liquid inside the Mysterious Gourd.

Whirring, the complex Divine Ability Imprint quickly formed.

In a blink, the Blood Rebirth Divine Ability was synchronized to Taiyin Primordial Spirit.

The Divine Ability Imprints Lin Yuan currently condensed were only suitable for his true body; other evolvers wouldn’t benefit even if they comprehended it thoroughly.

However, the body of Taiyin Primordial Spirit was completely transformed according to Lin Yuan’s true body, almost identical, so all Divine Ability Imprints could be shared.

“Absorb it.”

Lin Yuan handed the Mysterious Gourd to Taiyin Primordial Spirit, letting it start absorbing from the first colored liquid.

Just then,

Lin Yuan suddenly received a message from the official human civilization.

“Respected Ninth Rank Evolver and Galaxy Master Lin Yuan, as a new entrant into the Ninth Rank, you need to come to the Central Star Domain soon…”

“A trip to the Central Star Domain?” Lin Yuan had already known about this.

Every new Ninth Rank Evolver had to visit the Central Star Domain, to soak in the cosmic rarity ‘Eternal Spring’ once.

‘Eternal Spring’, a Twelve-Star cosmic rarity, even higher ranked than the World Tree, was a treasure at the level of supreme beings.

The waters of the ‘Eternal Spring’ were greatly beneficial to newly entered Ninth Rank Evolvers, especially in terms of the physical body; although the inner world was most important for Ninth Rank Evolvers, the physical body was also crucial.

Especially for those Ninth Rank Evolvers skilled in the physical body evolution path.

‘Eternal Spring’ was indeed an unmatched great opportunity.

“Fine, I’ll take a trip to the Central Star Domain.”

Lin Yuan’s true body rose, stepped out of the Milky Way Main Star, and merely with one step, thousands of light-years flashed under his feet.
